verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships GUI-free entry points: an `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, a one-shot chat CLI, a macOS CLI/daemon, and a Python `AutoEngine` API. Together these make headless operation plausible. However, nothing documents running in server or CI environments specifically, and the only listed native GPU-server backend (CUDA) is a reserved, unimplemented slot. Missing for 10: explicit headless server/CI deployment docs, documented Linux/server-platform support (CUDA backend not yet implemented), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless operation in CI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: One-shot chat (pass --max-new to cap length; add --show-thinking to print the model's reasoning block too)
macOS: local CLI / daemon / desktop app (Rust)
